meaning.evidence: Both vector panels show a rounded rectangle with a horizontal top bar and hollow interior (a window/frame), with a padlock at lower right whose arched shackle sits over a body containing a keyhole slot. No folder tab, pause bars, or lens is present.
meaning.treatment: None; concept reads correctly in both renditions.

separation.evidence: At native 1x, P's padlock (lower right, ~x=13-19, y=11-20) is ringed by white pixels and the frame's bottom stroke stops short of it, a real coverage gap. In Q the padlock's ink runs continuously into the frame's bottom-right corner ink with no white pixel between them.
separation.treatment: For Q: move the padlock ~1px up and left and knock a full-pixel white keyline between the lock outline and the frame's bottom-right corner so the boundary survives at 24px.

shackle.evidence: In P at native 1x the lock column shows two separate white pixels: an upper opening inside the shackle arch (~y=13-14) and the lower keyhole (~y=16-17). Both persist in the 2x panel and in the inverted row, so the upper loop is not filled.
